channel.title: Bloombot news
channel.description: Updates and announcements from Bloombot, the Garden Tower Defense trading bot.

item.title: New: unit pages, your collection and price alerts
item.description: Every unit gets its own page, track what your units are worth, get a DM when a price moves, make real offers in chats, and upvote the best strategies.

item.title: Turkey Mode, Global Trading quick access, Turkey Hut and Cornucopia
item.description: Turn every enemy into an Evil Turkey, open Global Trading straight from the Trade UI, and grab two new Thanksgiving units.

item.title: AFK Zen Garden, spectating and Ranked 2 vs 2
item.description: Plant units in your AFK Zen Garden to earn Seeds, livestream and watch games, and play Ranked 2 vs 2 PvP.

item.title: Message other traders on the website
item.description: Private chats right on Bloombot, with pictures, emojis and a chat filter. Plus a farm calculator for Seeds and Fertilizer per hour.

item.title: Website update: levels, crate calculator, profiles and more
item.description: Levels with one-time XP tasks, an in-game style crate calculator, profile popups, Google login, Roblox verify, a server dashboard and a light mode.

item.title: Halloween Part 3: 2 vs 2 PvP, Fantasy Survival and endless Daily Rewards
item.description: Team up in 2 vs 2 PvP, play Fantasy Frontier Survival, get free x1.5 and x2 Survival speed, and Daily Rewards that never end.

item.title: The Bloombot website is here!
item.description: Everything Bloombot does in Discord, now in your browser too. Values, a trade calculator, trade ads and strategies, with one-click Discord login.

item.title: Halloween Part 2: new PvP season, Petriflora and Nullshade
item.description: A PvP season refresh, friends leaderboards, an option to hide in-game notifications and two new Candy units.

item.title: Halloween Part 1: Maze Massacre, Night Mode and the Skull Crate
item.description: A new Halloween map with 11 enemies and the Boneweaver boss, intense Night Mode, Blood Moon waves, Candy and a Skull Crate with 8 units.

item.title: Pushpetal, Inversia, faster PvP and Survival in Sandbox
item.description: PvP gets x2 and x3 speed, Survival Mode comes to Sandbox and two new limited stock units drop.

item.title: Traits are here, plus the new Fertilizer currency
item.description: 22 new Traits, the Fertilizer currency to roll them, free Trait Incubators, and a map wave overhaul to fight power creep.

item.title: Parasite Plant, Shockfrost Sprout and the Freeze rework
item.description: Freeze now stacks to stall enemies, top units get locked in PvP each week and two new limited stock units arrive.

item.title: New map ratings, Ability UI, Mortarfern and Chronorchid
item.description: Skulls now show how hard each level is, the Ability UI is smaller, storage holds up to 7,525 units and a new PvP season starts.

item.title: Trithorn, shorter PvP waves, Scopeleaf and Triangrove
item.description: A Daily Reward exclusive unit, a Unit Keyword guide, shorter and faster PvP matches and easier Fantasy Frontier waves.

item.title: Unit Lock, Slay Stem and Ampiflora
item.description: Lock your special units so they can't be deleted or traded by accident, plus two new limited stock units.

item.title: Fantasy Frontier has dropped!
item.description: A new 6-level map with 12 fantasy enemies including the Flyvern boss, 10 themed units and a limited time Fantasy Summon.

item.title: Daily Reward units, PvP overhaul, Crate Pity and Autoplay
item.description: 15 days of Daily Reward units, Autoplay, a big PvP Mode overhaul with a new season, and Pity on the Original Crate.

item.title: Custom Clan Base, Clan Stars, Medusa Flower and Bouncebloom
item.description: Decorate your Clan Base, show it off to everyone, and summon base items with the new Clan Stars currency.

item.title: Rose Royale duplicates and trade-locked accounts explained
item.description: No Rose Royale units were duplicated, and purchases on trade-locked accounts don't affect unit stock.

item.title: Bigger Clans and a PvP matchmaking overhaul
item.description: Clans can grow to 25 players and get custom icons, Clan Quests got easier, and PvP matchmaking is much faster.
